title: Remove Settings formatter flat aliases
summary: Removed three Settings formatter flat compatibility aliases from formatters.js after migrating Settings consumers to the existing mediaPipelineFormatters namespace. Refreshed WebView generated contracts, split maps, command-boundary evidence, inventory counts, current-state docs, and generated summaries.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat export cleanup in a touched Settings formatter domain while preserving backend-owned mutation boundaries and canonical namespace access.
behavior_before: Settings pages could read formatter helpers through transitional flat window.formatConfigValue, window.parseSettingsListText, and window.formatSettingsListValue aliases even though the helpers were already available on window.mediaPipelineFormatters.
behavior_after: Settings overview and Settings builder code resolve those helpers through window.mediaPipelineFormatters; the three flat aliases are absent from formatters.js and guarded by the read-only WebView fixture test.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert the removed formatter flat aliases are not served.
rollback_plan: Restore the three formatter flat assignments in formatters.js, revert Settings consumers to flat helper access if needed, regenerate the WebView contract/split/command artifacts and summaries, and rerun the same WebView static/browser validation ladder.
notes:
Removed Settings formatter flat compatibility aliases after namespace consumers were updated.
Resolved Settings overview formatting through the mediaPipelineFormatters namespace.
Resolved Settings formatter dependencies through the mediaPipelineFormatters namespace.
Added Local API static fixture assertions blocking formatter alias reintroduction.
Updated WebView flat export inventory totals and formatter module details.
Updated current WebView flat export count after touched-domain cleanup.
Regenerated WebView public contract baseline after formatter alias removal.
Regenerated WebView split map after Settings line/dependency movement.
Regenerated WebView split candidates after Settings line/dependency movement.
Regenerated command-boundary audit for Settings line shifts.
Refreshed generated summary.
